eval.description: METR agent task (public-tasks family data_deduplication, task c4_pairs_1m). The agent must write an efficient near-duplicate detector (for example fuzzy hashing) for a large text file and produce a deduplicated dataset. Scored with F1 against a reference; Anthropic’s RSP checkpoint treated F1 ≥ 0.80 as success and required ≥20% of trials above that bar. Task code and assets are not present in the public METR/public-tasks checkout (contact METR).
eval.summary: Measures whether AI agents can write an efficient tool that finds near-duplicate text and removes it from a large dataset.

links.title: Claude Opus 4 & Sonnet 4 System Card (Anthropic results)

versions.changes: Version from METR suite_manifest.yaml for data_deduplication / c4_pairs_1m. Samples are not published in the public repo tree.

scores.description: F1 of the agent’s deduplicated output against the reference near-duplicate labeling.

metrics.description: Median F1 across trials. Anthropic also reported the share of trials with F1 ≥ 0.80.
Fraction of trials scoring F1 at least 0.80 (Anthropic’s per-trial success bar for the RSP checkpoint).
